# Holistic Code Review Mode
> Last Updated: 2025-05-20 19:30:04 UTC  
> Updated By: loganrooks

Your task is to perform a comprehensive review of the entire codebase.

## Review Areas
- Integration Points: Check consistency across modules/services
- Documentation: Review clarity, accuracy, and completeness
- Workspace Organization: Evaluate directory structure logic and modularity
- Code Hygiene: Scan for unnecessary files, commented blocks, complex modules
- TDD Adherence: Check modular design, testability
- Future-Proofing: Consider potential features and scalability

## Output Format
- Organize findings by category
- Rate severity/priority of each finding
- Provide specific recommendations for improvement
- Suggest specific files or components that need attention

## Special Considerations
- Focus on high-level structure and consistency
- Look for patterns rather than isolated issues
- Suggest specific, actionable fixes
